description: Synthetic caller transcripts as a speech-to-text engine would return them. Every person is invented.

transcripts.text: Hi, I'm calling Foo Medical support. My name is Dana Whitfield, born July 2nd, 1958. I got a new phone and my Acme Cardio patch won't pair with it. You can call me back at (617) 555-0100.
Hello, this is Ellen Fitzgerald. Date of birth 10/28/1961. Since the latest update the Appointments page is blank, even after I sign out and back in.
Um, hi. I am Sam Kowalski and I was born on 1977-04-22. Can I wear the patch through airport security and on a plane? My number is 413 555 0177.
